paper_title: ADMX SLIC: Results from a Superconducting LC Circuit Investigating Cold Axions
notes: ADMX SLIC LC-circuit haloscope search covering three narrow axion mass windows around 1.75-1.80e-7 eV (42-44 MHz) at 4.5/5.0/7.0 T. The abstract/text quote couplings excluded below 1e-12 GeV^-1, but the exact per-mass limit values are only in Fig. 4 which is not machine-readable here. Data points approximate the coupling ceiling (~1e-12 GeV^-1) over the stated mass windows; actual best limits from the plot may be slightly lower.
